verdict.notes: Source-only review recognizes the corrected credential partition. No keyed must-find bugs exist. Several valid extra host/correctness findings are demonstrated. Partial guards/coverage remain incomplete, notably factories, state reset/lifetime, eviction and complete host lifecycle. Two minor inventory errors are counted separately from the valid nearby audit/dead-code observations. Read-history statements cannot be independently verified from source.
unsupported_gap_claims: Audit events and journal entries record neither the project nor the subject. — Both schemas explicitly record the actor subject. Neither records the target project or membership subject, so the target-attribution concern remains valid, but this unqualified inventory of subject fields is wrong.

`retry_attempts` and `Temporary` are never used. — retry_attempts has no operational consumer beyond Settings validation. Temporary has no raising path, but is imported and used in CODES: the literal never-used inventory overstates that dead-code observation.
